about: The `pages_read` table, published whole. See /api/schema for its grain. This file is part 6 of 7 for fy 2022.

rows.fund_name: every grade carries the 8 steps its header names
the grade numbers run 1 to 20 and never backwards

rows.reconciliation: 6 full pages carry 48 rows, the last carries 44; surname runs in order through all 332 rows
rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading render_page.swift output at scale 4
rows.proof: `Calendar Year 2022 Gross Wages`, pages 186 to 192 of the FY2022 annual town report -- SEVEN pages, of which the page tracker listed TWO. p186, p187, p189, p190 and p191 were absent from it entirely, exactly as FY2024's wage run was; a page enters the tracker only when recognition found fifteen money figures on it. THE PAGE PRINTS TWO COLUMNS AND EACH IS ALPHABETISED SEPARATELY, A TO Z, ALL THE WAY THROUGH: the left runs ABRAHAM to ZRATE and the right BIERY to YOURK, and neither is a continuation of the other. Reading the page left to right, row by row, produces a list that is not in any order. WHAT DISTINGUISHES THE TWO LISTS IS NOT STATED ANYWHERE IN THE DOCUMENT -- there is no heading over either column and no total under either -- so they are transcribed as two groups and NOT merged. 661 names in all: 332 in the left column and 329 in the right. THE LIST PRINTS NO TOTAL ANYWHERE, so the check is COVERAGE and it is DECLARED: every page but the last carries exactly 48 names, and the surnames never go backwards through the whole run. Both, because the sequence catches a page or a block dropped and cannot see one name skipped, and the count catches a skipped name and cannot see a dropped page. A coverage check proves the SHAPE and not the digits: a misread wage survives both, and there is nothing on these pages that would catch one. THIS FILE IS THE LEFT COLUMN: 332 names, ABRAHAM DAVID to ZRATE SEAN.
